title: add-single-events-multiple-event-groups.html
content: Pre-Requisites Caching 2.0 Caching 2.0 must be enabled to use the Multiple Event Groups feature. If it is not enabled, users will see an error when creating or updating an {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record. Post-Install Script After upgrading {{variable.Product_Events}} via the {{variable.Link_CandyShop}} , a post-install script will process existing {{variable.Object_Event}} s with a value in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} field to create {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} records. If an {{variable.Object_Event}} has a value in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} field before upgrading to the new version, the upgraded version of {{variable.Product_Events}} will automatically create an {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record with the “Event Name” in the {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} field and the “Event Group Name” in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} field. If an {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} field is blank, the upgraded version of {{variable.Product_Events}} will not create an {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record. Please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to run the script or for additional support. Overview Benefits Previously, {{variable.Object_Event}} s and {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} s had a one-to-one relationship, or a single {{variable.Object_Event}} could only be associated with one {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . Now, a single {{variable.Object_Event}} can be related to one {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} or multiple {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} s. This feature gives Event Organizers the ability to Maximize engagement by cross-marketing a single {{variable.Object_Event}} to multiple audiences. Increase registrations and boost ticket, product, and donation sales. Create calendars/event lists for specific groups and interests that overlap. Maintain a master events calendar as well as support a smaller, focused calendar used by a program or department. New Functionality The {{variable.Object_Event}} object’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) field has been updated as follows. The new Field Label for the conference360__Event_Group__c field is now {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} . The Description/Help text is now: “Select an Event Group for this Event. All Events grouped together will appear on the same list. To view the list, click on the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupURL}} field on the Event Group record. If this Event is related to multiple Event Groups, then the value from this field will be used as the primary Event Group.” If an {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to multiple {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} s, the value selected in the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) field will be used as the primary {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . The existing {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} (conference360_Event_Group_Association_c) object is now the junction object between the {{variable.Object_Event}} and {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} objects. Relevant Fields on the Event Group Association Object Field Label: {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventURL}} API Name: conference360__Event_URL__c Data Type: Formula Help Text/Description: Event URL related to this event group Field Label: {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} API Name: conference360__Event_Group__c Data Type: Lookup Field Label: {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} API Name: conference360__Event__c Data Type: Lookup Updated Permission Sets Permission Sets: Blackthorn | Events (Admin), Blackthorn | Events (Organizer), and Blackthorn | Events (Community/Platform User) Object: Event Group Association Object Permissions Read Create Edit Delete Field Permissions {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} : Read, Edit {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} : Read, Edit {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventURL}} : Read Permission Sets: Blackthorn | Events (Lite User), Blackthorn | Events (Read Only), and Blackthorn | Events (Limited Access) Object: Event Group Association Object Permission: Read Field Permissions {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} : Read {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} : Read {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventURL}} : Read Required Page Layout Updates Add the {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}} to the {{variable.Object_Event}} and {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} page layouts. Go to the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab. Click the Upgrade tab. Click the Upgrade Events Layouts button. Logic In Salesforce The following {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} logic explains how single {{variable.Object_Event}} s can be related to multiple E {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} s. Case 1 If you set the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) field to “EventGroup1,” and the {{variable.Object_Event}} has no related {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record, then the {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to the {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record. The new {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record includes {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event" and {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup1." Case 2 An {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) field is blank, and the {{variable.Object_Event}} has no related {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record. You create a new {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record with the {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) set to “EventGroup2.” The {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field now contains “EventGroup2.” Case 3 An {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) field is set to “EventGroup1,” and the {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to an {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record with {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event" and {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup1." If you delete the {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record, then the {{variable.Object_Event}} will no longer be related to an {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record because the {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} , “EventGroup1,” is automatically removed from the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field. Case 4 The {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) field is set to “EventGroup1,” and the {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to an {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record with {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event" and {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup1." The value in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field is changed to “EventGroup2,” updating the related {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record to “ {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event" and {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup2." Case 5 The {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) field is set to “EventGroup1,” and the {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to the following {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} records. {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event" and {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup1" {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event" and {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup3" The value in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field is changed to “EventGroup2,” which creates a third {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record. {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event", {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup1" {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event", {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup3" {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event", {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup2" Case 6 The {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) field is set to “EventGroup1,” and the {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to the following {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} records. {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup1" {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup2" The value in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field has been removed, and the field is now blank. This deletes the {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record with {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} = "EventGroup1” and leaves one {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record remaining. {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup2" Case 7 The {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) field is set to “EventGroup1,” and the {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to the following {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} records. {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup1," and {{variable.Field_SF_CreatedDate}} = ”02/03” {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup2," and {{variable.Field_SF_CreatedDate}} = ”02/04” {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "this event," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup3," and {{variable.Field_SF_CreatedDate}} = ”02/05” The value in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field is removed, causing the {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field to be automatically changed from “null” to “EventGroup2” since “EventGroup2” is the oldest {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . Case 8 The {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} record with {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event1" and {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "EventGroup2" exists in an org. If a user tries to create a duplicate record, they will see this error: “This Event Group Association already exists; you cannot add a duplicate.” Attendee Experiences Scenario 1: View an Event associated with one Event Group Event A contains the following values: {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = “Event Group A” {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} (conference360__Event_Group_Association__c) = null From Event Group A’s webpage, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} goes to Event A, which has {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} set to “Event Group A.” When the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks the Back Arrow on Event A, they are taken to Event Group A. Scenario 2: View an Event associated with multiple Event Groups Event A contains the following values: {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = null {{variable.Field_EV_EventGroupAssociation}} (conference360__Event_Group_Association__c) = null Event A is associated with Event Group A, Event Group B, and Event Group C, but Event A’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} field is blank. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} goes to Event Group A’s {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupURL}} , they see and select Event A. From Event A, they can click the Back Arrow on Event A and go to Event Group A. Scenario 3: View an Event across multiple Event Groups Event A’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) is set to “Event Group A.” Event A is also associated with Event Group B, Event Group C, and Event Group D. {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event A," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group B” {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event A," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group C” {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event A," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group D” When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} goes to each {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} , they will see Event A is listed under Related Events. Scenario 4: Assign an Event Group ID based on the Event Group Scenario 4.1: View an Event with an Event Group ID from Event Group A Event A’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) is set to “Event Group A.” Event A is associated with Event Group B, Event Group C, and Event Group D. {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event A," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group B” {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event A," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group C” {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event A," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group D” From Event Group A’s webpage, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} sees and clicks Event A. When the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks the Back Arrow on Event A, they are taken back to Event Group A since the {{variable.Field_SF_EventGroupID}} associated with Event A comes from the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} where the {{variable.Object_Event}} was opened. Scenario 4.2: View an Event with the Event Group ID from Event Group B Event A’s {{variable.Field_Event_PrimaryEventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) is set to “Event Group A.” Event A is associated with Event Group B, Event Group C, and Event Group D. {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event A," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group B” {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event A," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group C” {{variable.Object_EventGroupAssociation}} : {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_Event}} (conference360__Event__c) = "Event A," {{variable.Field_EVGrpAssoc_EventGroup}} (conference360__Event_Group__c) = "Event Group D” From Event Group B’s webpage, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} sees and clicks Event A. When the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks the Back Arrow on Event A, they are taken back to Event Group B since the {{variable.Field_SF_EventGroupID}} associated with Event A comes from Event Group B.
